subject: Veridian Health — security intake: SOC 2, IR timeline & BCP evidence

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodai.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodai.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + security items from today

Alicia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can keep momentum: 

- Demo highlights: single-tenant model pinning, predictable latency SLAs, and per-route cost telemetry. You confirmed the main production use case will handle PHI and regional residency requirements.
- Next steps from Veridian: security intake + vendor QA so your InfoSec/legal teams can sign off.

Can you confirm the following so we route correctly?
1) SOC 2 scope required (Type I/II, specific trust services).
2) Your preferred timeline for receiving incident response / breach notification commitments (e.g., 24/48/72 hr).
3) Any specific evidence you need for BCP/DR (tables, failover RTO/RPO, test history).

I've CC'd Soojin (solutions) and Evelyn (sales lead) — Soojin will coordinate on the vendor questionnaire and share artifacts. If easier, send over your intake form and we'll populate it.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m follow-up with your security team next week.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien

connor_obrien@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Connor — great demo, thanks. A few things from InfoSec/legal side: 

1) We require a SOC 2 Type II report covering Security + Availability. If you have an authoritative summary or bridge letter while the full report is processed, please send.
2) For incident response: our policy requires initial notification to our security lead within 72 hours of detection and a regulatory-ready timeline within 7 business days. Please confirm you can meet that cadence.
3) BCP/DR: we typically ask for an RTO/RPO table and most recent test dates.
4) Attached is our vendor intake form (vendor_intake_form_veridian.pdf) — please complete and return.

Also copy our legal mailbox (legal@veridianhealth.com) if there are DPA/BHA questions.

Can you provide a point-of-contact for security evidence and an expected turnaround? We're aiming to complete intake by 2026-04-02.

Thanks,

1) SOC 2: attach a sanitized summary (redwood_soc2_summary_v2.pdf). Full report in progress; we can provide a bridge letter.
2) IR & breach notification: our policy is to notify customers and affected parties within 72 hours of confirmed detection; our internal detection-to-analysis SLA is 24 hours. I'm attaching an excerpt from our IR runbook describing roles and notification owners (redwood_ir_runbook_excerpt.txt).
3) BCP/DR: I'll extract the RTO/RPO table and latest test artifacts (bcp_dr_table.csv). We typically include the last two test dates and outcomes.

I suggest we deliver the intake form answers and the three attachments by EOD 2026-03-30. If Veridian requires a signed DPA/BAA, loop in legal and we can route for signature (DocuSign).

Alicia / Veridian legal — thanks for the clear asks. Attached are the artifacts Neha prepared: a SOC 2 summary, an IR runbook excerpt, and our BCP table. We've completed the vendor intake form with the items we can share; see inline answers below and the Drive link for full docs: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/veridian-vd-4821/security-pack

Inline answers to key intake questions:
- SOC 2: Type II (Security + Availability). Most recent audit period: 2025-10 through 2026-03. Full report available under NDA; attached is a summary and control mapping.
- Incident response / notification: initial notification to the customer security lead within 72 hours of confirmed detection; interim updates as investigations progress; final remediation summary within 30 days unless extended by coordination. Our legal/ops owners are named in the runbook excerpt.
- BCP/DR: RTO/RPO table attached (bcp_dr_table.csv). We perform DR tests quarterly; last full failover test: 2026-01-12, successful.

Proposed next step: a 45-minute security deep-dive so Neha can walk through the IR runbook and answer any regulator-specific questions. Proposed window: 2026-03-30 at 14:00 ET / 11:00 PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a Teams link.

If you need a signed DPA/BAA, please indicate and we'll route to Legal — we can prepare a DocuSign packet. HubSpot ticket created: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/VD-4821

1) Data residency: can you confirm whether any PHI processing is routed through non-US regions by default? Need explicit confirmation of US-only processing for this scope.

If you can send those two items ahead of the 3/30 meeting that would be ideal — we'll keep legal on the thread in case we need to expedite a BAA. Meeting time looks good; I'll accept the invite once received.

Thanks — Alicia
